question: The Indian Ocean covers an area of about 73 million km², about _________ of the total area covered by the world's oceans.
solution:
The correct answer is **__20%.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The** Indian Ocean**__ covers an area of about __**73 million km**____**2**__, about __**20%**__ of the __**total area covered**__ by the __**world's oceans**__.

 __
 
• The Indian Ocean is the smallest of the three major oceans, with a surface area of** 73 million square kilometres** (28 million square miles), or about **20 percent **of the total **ocean surface area.**
 
• **3,890 metres **is the **average depth** of the Indian Ocean (12,762 feet).
 
• The **Java trench **is its **deepest point**, measuring **7,725 metres.**
 
• Among the present **problems **are: -
 
 
• **Oil pollution** in the Arabian Sea, Persian Gulf, and Red Sea;
 
• **Endangered marine animals **include the **dugong, seals, turtles, **and **whales.**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The Indian Oceans **northern**, **western**, and **eastern borders **are formed by** Asia, Africa, and Australia.**
 
• Depending on the term being used, it is bordered to the south by either **Antarctica **or the **Southern Ocean.**
 
• The **Arabian Sea, Laccadive Sea, Bay of Bengal, **and **Andaman Sea** are only a few of the **large marginal** or **regional seas **that the **Indian Ocean possesses** along its centre.
 
• Since at least **1515**, when the Latin name **Oceanus Orientalis Indicus **("Indian Eastern Ocean") is documented and named after India, which projects into it, the **Indian Ocean **has been referred to by its current name.
 
• Prior to the discovery of the **Pacific**, it was referred to as the **Eastern **Ocean, a name that was still in use in the middle of the **18th century.**
